run_slurm_job: run a SLURM array job with conda env, script path, config files, and retry logic
requeue_job: requeue a SLURM array job using scontrol requeue with the current job and task ID
handle_sigusr1: handle SIGUSR1 signal by requeuing the current SLURM array job before it is killed
handle_sigterm: handle SIGTERM signal by bypassing it to prevent job preemption on the SLURM cluster
run_os_cmd: run a bash command in the foreground using os.system with a bash shell
